raw data query for GOA/BSAI sharks

sharks.Rd

raw data query for GOA/BSAI sharks

Usage

sharks(year, area)

Arguments

year

assessment year

area

what region? eith goa or bsai

Value

a suite of raw data .csv files and a time stamp of when the query was done

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
sharks(year = 2023, area = "goa")
} # }
